Company Description
 Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies, and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts, and combines delivering results with enjoyment.
 Job Description
 Project – the aim you’ll have
 Our client is a gaming company established to reform the national gaming system. Operating under the principle of exclusivity, its mission is to provide games responsibly, mitigate gambling-related risks, and ensure player protection while preventing fraud.
The company offers a wide range of games divided into three main categories: Lucky Games, Casino Games, and Betting Games. It emphasizes operating responsibly and contributing to a safe and secure gaming environment.
 Role – How You’ll Contribute
Design, develop, and maintain mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript.
Build user-friendly, responsive, and accessible mobile experiences for consumer customers.
Develop reusable and maintainable mobile components, following clean code principles and engineering best practices.
Implement and maintain application state management using Redux Saga.
Work with Expo and other tools to support mobile application development and deployment.
Integrate mobile applications with backend services and third-party platforms.
Contribute to improving application performance, stability, and overall user experience.
Implement and maintain accessibility features in mobile applications.
Participate in A/B testing activities to evaluate and improve mobile user experiences.
Use Firebase and App Center CodePush to support mobile application functionality and updates.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
 Qualifications
 Expectations – the experience you need
At least 3 years of full-time professional experience in mobile application development using React Native and TypeScript.
More than 4 years of professional experience with React Native.
More than 4 years of professional experience with TypeScript.
Practical experience implementing accessibility features in mobile applications.
Experience with A/B testing in mobile applications.
Experience developing services for consumer customers.
Hands-on experience with Redux Saga.
Hands-on experience with Expo.
Hands-on experience with Firebase.
Hands-on experience with App Center CodePush.
 Additional Skills – The Edge You Have
Experience developing scalable and maintainable mobile application architectures.
Experience optimizing mobile application performance and user experience.
Familiarity with modern mobile development practices and tools.
Experience working in cross-functional Agile teams.
